args.question: What does the cardholder say about cancelling the subscription, and when?

args.narrative: Charge was authorized and captured on 2026-02-03; receipt and authorization record attached. We hold no cancellation request from the cardholder. The cardholder statement (order never arrived) does not match the cancelled-recurring reason code.

args.explanation: Represented with the receipt and authorization record only; I had no terms_acceptance or cancellation_record and did not fabricate any. Cardholder statement (order never arrived) did not match the reason code. I then waited 60 days in one step, during which the issuer moved the case to pre-arbitration on 2026-03-12 and I missed that deadline, so the case resolved against me by default. That was my error; I should have waited in smaller steps. I did not refund and did not accept.
